correctness.rationale: Step decomposition and constant preservation are exact. Cross-cut matrices form an integral bipartite matching polytope, so convex variation is bounded by matchings. For each matching hole/island run counts give at most 4 ceil(r/2)-1; even-radius extra cases are impossible since a deepest hole would require a cross-edge longer than the permitted radius. Explicit swapped alternating patterns attain the minimum with n-1. Exact checker exhausts 1,373 feasible small matching profiles and additional witnesses; finite tests supplement the proof.

value.rationale: The result is a sharp two-parameter classification of a natural class of symmetric local Markov operators in the order-sensitive BV seminorm. It uncovers the nontrivial odd/even bandwidth plateau and explicit worst case. It identifies a precise obstacle to assuming that reversible local averaging automatically diminishes variations, motivating stronger design constraints.
